sahneler.metin: Fire broke out on the carrier Oriskany off Vietnam.
It spread through the ship, and forty four people were killed.
A flare had been accidentally ignited.
The sailor holding it threw it into a flare locker.
The other flares were about to ignite.
Pressure made the locker door impossible to open.
Within five minutes, the locker exploded.

aciklama:
USS Oriskany caught fire off Vietnam. The cause: an accidentally ignited flare setting off hundreds of flares in a sealed locker.

#shorts #engineering #firesafety
